{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Maypearl to Malone Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nsenergybusiness.com/news/newsenergy_transfer_partners_completes_two_north_texas_gas_pipeline_projects/|title=nsenergybusiness.com|website=nsenergybusiness.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Maypearl, Texas to Malone, Texas.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nsenergybusiness.com/news/newsenergy_transfer_partners_completes_two_north_texas_gas_pipeline_projects/|title=nsenergybusiness.com|website=nsenergybusiness.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Energy Transfer LP<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nsenergybusiness.com/news/newsenergy_transfer_partners_completes_two_north_texas_gas_pipeline_projects/|title=nsenergybusiness.com|website=nsenergybusiness.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''600 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nsenergybusiness.com/news/newsenergy_transfer_partners_completes_two_north_texas_gas_pipeline_projects/|title=nsenergybusiness.com|website=nsenergybusiness.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''25 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nsenergybusiness.com/news/newsenergy_transfer_partners_completes_two_north_texas_gas_pipeline_projects/|title=nsenergybusiness.com|website=nsenergybusiness.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''36 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nsenergybusiness.com/news/newsenergy_transfer_partners_completes_two_north_texas_gas_pipeline_projects/|title=nsenergybusiness.com|website=nsenergybusiness.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nsenergybusiness.com/news/newsenergy_transfer_partners_completes_two_north_texas_gas_pipeline_projects/|title=nsenergybusiness.com|website=nsenergybusiness.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
